The package follows standard AUR packaging practices: it uses pinned sources, applies minimal necessary patches, builds with CMake, and installs into `$pkgdir`. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, remote code execution, or tampering with system files beyond what is needed for functionality. While the package skips installing tests (`BUILD_TESTING=OFF`), this is common in AUR packages and not a security concern.
